messages:
vivian: Putting together a new Grafana dashboard focused on GPU power/capacity and tenant-aware SLOs. Want panels + alert tuning suggestions.

matthew: +1. Key things: show node-level power cap vs actual wattage, and a rack-aggregated power budget panel. Annotate powercap events from node-exporter.

alex: Also surface thermal margin (fan curve headroom). If margin < 5% for >2m, we should treat as high-risk. Link to runbook in the panel.

sam: Can we filter by tenant (k8s namespace / owner label)? Need per-tenant GPU utilization and burst budget so we can bill/backpressure.

vivian: Yes — use namespace/owner labels. Proposed PromQL for per-namespace avg power (5m):
```
sum by (namespace) (avg_over_time(nvidia_gpu_power_watts{namespace!~""}[5m]))
```
And for node power cap vs draw (per node):
```
node_powercap_watts - avg_over_time(nvidia_gpu_power_watts[5m])
```
We can expose a template var `${namespace}` and `${region}`.

matthew: For alerts, I'd do something like:
```
expr: (node_powercap_watts - avg_over_time(nvidia_gpu_power_watts[5m])) < 200
for: 10m
labels: { severity: "page" }
```
Meaning power cap is within 200W of cap for 10m. Debounce on lower severity.

alex: Make sure to add a cardinality guard so noisy namespaces don't page. e.g. only escalate if >2 nodes in the same rack or >5% of fleet.

infra-bot: dashboard created: grafana/prod/gpu-power-slo (id:2345) — preview: https://grafana.internal/d/2345/gpu-power-slo

sam: Can we add a cheap cost-estimate panel that multiplies kWh by $/kWh per region? Good for monthly infra chargebacks.

vivian: Good idea. We'll add a templated `cost_per_kwh` variable and region lookup. Also plan to include NVLink/PCIe power if exporters provide it.

alex: Keep initial dashboard to <10 panels: overview row (total power, avg temp, thermal margin), top-5 hottest nodes, per-tenant consumption, rack budgets, active powercap alerts. Less noise = easier adoption.

matthew: I'll open a PR in infra/grafana-dashboards with the JSON and add the alert rules + runbook links. Assigning to myself to follow up. :thumbsup:

vivian: Please include a small section in the dashboard for mitigation steps (reduce batch size, move jobs to dedicated capacity, apply per-tenant throttles). Link to SLO doc.

infra-bot: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/grafana-dashboards/pull/412 — preview dashboard will auto-update when CI finishes.

matthew: I'll also add a playbook snippet to alerts: how to check powercap history, how to force a node drain safely, and where to request temporary burst capacity.

vivian: Awesome. Once PR merges, let's run it by ML infra next week and collect feedback before enabling paging rules.

alex: Agreed. For paging, start with paging to infra-oncall only, then expand to owners after 1 week of validation.

sam: Thanks all — excited to see tenant-level cost+power visibility.

vivian: Thanks — I'll put a short README in the dashboard JSON with the variables and recommended thresholds.
